cap: A tour of the tract at mid-cycle. The follicle ruptures about 36 hours after the LH surge begins, and the fluid can cause brief one-sided pain called mittelschmerz. Ciliated cells of the fallopian tube carry the oocyte toward the uterus, and Kartagener syndrome disables them. Peak estradiol makes endocervical mucus thin and stretchy. The ectocervix is nonkeratinized stratified squamous epithelium that meets the columnar endocervix at the transformation zone.
